crop.notes: Complete chapter from the 'John L. as I Knew Him by James J. Corbett' banner to '(To Be Continued Tomorrow.)'.

ocr.notes: Accurate; 'January 15, 1861' should be 'January 18, 1861', and 'As John L. Sullivan ever' should be 'Was John L. Sullivan ever'. Subheads not transcribed.

title.suggested: John L. As I Knew Him, chapter 20 (Corbett)

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Star printed a chapter of James J. Corbett's Sullivan series tracing the championship line, saying Allen claimed the British title, came to America and lost to McCoole on a foul in St. Louis in 1869.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The St. Louis Star, Tuesday Evening, March 12, 1918', page 13. Twentieth chapter, King Feature Syndicate.

facts.fact: Corbett wrote that Allen, after vainly challenging Mace, claimed the British heavyweight title, then came to the United States
Allen and Mike McCoole fought in St. Louis for the heavyweight championship of the world; McCoole won on a foul in the ninth round, but Allen refused to concede his claim

notes: Mostly about the Sullivan-Kilrain fight and the early championship line; Allen appears in the last two paragraphs.
